FLOW_BUILDER.DESCRIPTION: Build WhatsApp conversation flows: menus, questions, order lookups and handoffs to your team. A flow answers its inboxes' new conversations until it hands them to humans.

LIST.NAME: Flow
LIST.EMPTY: No flows yet. Create one to answer WhatsApp conversations automatically.
LIST.LIVE: {n} conversation in the flow | {n} conversations in the flow
LIST.EMPTY_HINT: Start from a ready-made template, or build one node by node. Either way it stays a draft until you publish it.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete {name}?
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: The flow and its versions are deleted. A published flow must be disabled first.

DISABLE.TITLE: Disable this flow?
DISABLE.DESCRIPTION: No new conversation will start in it, and conversations in it now go to your team.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The draft could not be saved.
API.PUBLISH_ERROR: The flow could not be published. Fix the problems shown on the canvas.
API.INBOX_CONNECTED: The inbox now answers with this flow.
API.CREATE_ERROR: The flow could not be created.
API.DELETE_ERROR: The flow could not be deleted.
API.DUPLICATE_ERROR: The flow could not be duplicated.
API.LOAD_ERROR: The flows could not be loaded.

FLOW_BUILDER.UNSAVED_CONFIRM: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
FLOW_BUILDER.ERRORS_TITLE: {n} problem to fix before publishing | {n} problems to fix before publishing

CONFIG.START_HINT: Every new conversation in a connected inbox starts here. Keywords and conditions are optional; when they do not match, the conversation goes to your team.
CONFIG.KEYWORDS: Start only when the first message contains
CONFIG.KEYWORDS_PLACEHOLDER: Type a word and press Enter
CONFIG.CHOICE_HINT: Each option has its own connection. Customers can tap an option, type its title or its number.
CONFIG.ASSIGN_AGENT_HINT: The agent owns the conversation from here: the flow may still send the next messages, then hands it over.

LOOKUP_MODES.ORDER_NUMBER: The order number the customer gives

CONFIG.LOOKUP_HINT: Only the customer's own orders are found. Use flow.order variables in the next messages.
CONFIG.WEBHOOK_HINT: The flow's state is posted to this URL, signed with the bot's secret. The flow does not wait for the answer.
CONFIG.TEMPLATE_HINT: Approved templates synced from WhatsApp for this flow's inboxes. A template can be sent after the 24-hour window, where a plain message cannot. If it cannot be sent, the flow follows "Failed", or hands the conversation to your team.
CONFIG.TEMPLATE_NONE: No approved WhatsApp template can be sent from these inboxes. Templates are synced from WhatsApp in the inbox settings.
CONFIG.TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE: This template is no longer available on these inboxes.

TEST.TITLE: Test the draft
TEST.HINT: The saved draft runs on the real runtime for a test contact. Nothing is sent, saved or posted.
TEST.NOT_STARTED: The flow did not start: the conversation would go to your team.
TEST.TOO_LONG: This test is too long. Start over.

REASONS.LEFT_BOT_PHASE: The conversation was opened, assigned or resolved
REASONS.SEND_LIMIT: Too many messages in a row
REASONS.VISIT_LIMIT: A node ran too many times
REASONS.INVALID_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE: The value does not fit the attribute

REASONS.TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED: The template is no longer approved
REASONS.TEMPLATE_NOT_ALLOWED: The template cannot be sent by a flow
